items.title: Govt estimates up to $4.75 billion needed for Bhotekoshi disaster recovery
items.summary: The government has estimated that Nepal will need between $4.7 billion and $4.75 billion for the rehabilitation and reconstruction of areas affected by the Rasuwa–Bhotekoshi disaster. However, the government requires $57 million for immediate recovery efforts, according to Maheshwar Dhakal, joint secretary and spokesperson for the Ministry of Agriculture, Forests and Environment. items.title: Insurers have paid just 4 percent of Bhotekoshi flood claims
items.summary: Payouts total Rs821.39 million against Rs20.9 billion in claims nearly two months after the disaster, with the final bill expected to rise.
